text: ① 14:00 英国9月CPI； ② 16:00 欧洲央行执委Cipollone讲话； ③ 17:00 黄仁勋将在柏林GTC大会演讲； ④ 21:00 英国央行行长贝利参加一场炉边闲聊； ⑤ 22:30 美国能源信息署（EIA）发布政府版原油库存周报； ⑥ 次日00:00 欧洲央行行长拉加德讲话； ⑦ 美股盘后 Meta、特斯拉、拉姆研究、德州仪器、IBM、德国思爱普Sap等发布业绩报告； ⑧ 次日05:45 新西兰三季度CPI； 微信小程序搜索“见闻历”，了解更多。
text_en: ① 14:00 UK September CPI; ② 16:00 ECB Executive Board member Cipollone speech; ③ 17:00 Jensen Huang to speak at GTC conference in Berlin; ④ 21:00 BoE Governor Bailey participates in a fireside chat; ⑤ 22:30 US Energy Information Administration (EIA) releases weekly government crude oil inventory report; ⑥ 00:00 next day ECB President Lagarde speech; ⑦ After US market close, Meta, Tesla, Lam Research, Texas Instruments, IBM, Germany's SAP and others release earnings reports; ⑧ 05:45 next day New Zealand Q3 CPI; Search "Jianwen Calendar" on WeChat mini programs for more.
